instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_FONTS: Add '@fontsource/unbounded' and '@fontsource/manrope' and '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono' to package.json immediately.
THEME_SETUP: Force dark mode in tailwind.config.js. There is no light mode for this brand.
CHART_LIBRARY: Use 'lightweight-charts' for the candlestick chart. It is faster and looks more professional than recharts for crypto.
ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for all page transitions and 'react-fast-marquee' for the price ticker tape.
SPIRITUAL_TOUCH: Use the 'hero_background' image with a low opacity overlay (20%) in the dashboard background to give it texture.
HYPER_ACTIVE: Prices must flash Green/Red on update. Use simple CSS animations for this.
NAVBAR: Create a floating glass navbar. It should not be stuck to the top edge (margin-top: 4).
LOGO: The user provided logo is the 'Spirit'. Place it prominently in the center of the Auth pages.
GRID: Use a dense Bento grid for the dashboard. Order Book and Chart should dominate.
NO_ROUNDED_CORNERS: Keep border-radius minimal (0px or 2px) for a sharp, precise, 'Blade Runner' feel.
DATA_TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, trade execution) for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use generic gray backgrounds. Use tinted blacks (#050505).
Text contrast must be high. Use white for primary text, not gray.
Interactive elements must provide immediate visual feedback (glow, color shift).
Use uppercase for labels to increase density and readability at small sizes.
Toasts must be styled with 'sonner' and match the dark/gold theme.
